backdown edge

Relationship edges between content, people and places (the model's graph).

On this page
  • backdown edge add
  • Arguments
  • Options
  • backdown edge from
  • Arguments
  • Options
  • backdown edge to
  • Arguments
  • Options
backdown edge [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

backdown edge add#

Add a relationship edge: SRC REL DST, each node as type:key.

backdown edge add [OPTIONS] <SRC> <REL> <DST>

Arguments#

<SRC>
&nbsp;
<REL>
&nbsp;
<DST>
&nbsp;

Options#

--data <DATA>
&nbsp;

backdown edge from#

Edges out of a node.

backdown edge from [OPTIONS] <SRC>

Arguments#

<SRC>
&nbsp;

Options#

--json
Print it as JSON, for scripts.

backdown edge to#

Edges into a node.

backdown edge to [OPTIONS] <DST>

Arguments#

<DST>
&nbsp;

Options#

--json
Print it as JSON, for scripts.

All of them also take the global options --db and --local.
